description: This photograph depicts a heathland or moorland landscape, visually consistent with the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) definition of such areas. The ground is predominantly covered by pale yellow and white mosses and lichens, forming gentle, undulating mounds and low-lying areas. Interspersed throughout this pale ground cover are patches of darker green, low-growing herbaceous vegetation or dwarf shrubs. The background features a hazy, light-coloured sky, with distant, indistinct hills visible. The scene reflects characteristic features of heathland and moorland ecosystems, including a high field layer cover (typically > 50%) and very low tree cover (< 10%), as found in various Atlantic, sub-Atlantic, sub-Continental, supra-Mediterranean, or Arctic moor regions.
